CustomField.formula: IF( OR( AND(!ISBLANK( Applicant1PersonalHealthNumber__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Applicant1MSPStatus__c))), AND(!ISBLANK( Applicant2PersonalHealthNumber__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Applicant2MSPStatus__c))), AND(!ISBLANK( Patient1PersonalHealthNumber__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Patient1MSPStatus__c))), AND(!ISBLANK( Patient2PersonalHealthNumber__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Patient2MSPStatus__c))), AND(!ISBLANK( Patient3PersonalHealthNumber__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Patient3MSPStatus__c))) ), "At least one person is not enrolled", IF( OR( TEXT(Applicant1MSPStatus__c) = "Not Enrolled", TEXT(Applicant2MSPStatus__c) = "Not Enrolled", TEXT(Patient1MSPStatus__c) = "Not Enrolled", TEXT(Patient2MSPStatus__c) = "Not Enrolled", TEXT(Patient3MSPStatus__c) = "Not Enrolled" ), "At least one person is not enrolled", "All Enrolled" ) )
CustomField.label: MSP Coverage Status
